symbols.name: ll.JsonValueType
symbols.summary: Parses the JSON string json and returns the JSON type constant (JSON_*) representing the value found at specifiers.

parameters.name: json
parameters.description: JSON string containing the value to query.

parameters.name: specifiers
parameters.description: A list of key names or array indices specifying the path to the value.

symbols.name: ll.Key2Name
symbols.summary: Returns a string containing the name of the prim or avatar specified by id. The target must be a valid, rezzed entity in the current region, otherwise an empty string is returned. Avatars return their legacy name.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the target avatar or prim in the same region.

symbols.name: ll.KeyCountKeyValue
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction requesting the total count of keys in the experience data store. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

symbols.name: ll.KeysKeyValue
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction to retrieve count keys from the experience data store starting at the zero-based index first. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event. Fails with XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND if out of bounds.

parameters.name: first
parameters.description: Zero-based start index of the keys to retrieve.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of keys to retrieve.

symbols.name: ll.Linear2sRGB
symbols.summary: Returns a sRGB colorspace vector converted from the linear RGB colorspace argument.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color vector in the linear RGB space to convert.

symbols.name: ll.LinkAdjustSoundVolume
symbols.summary: Adjusts the volume of the currently playing sound attached to the linked prim link (has no effect on sounds started with llTriggerSound).

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag of the prim to adjust.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.LinkParticleSystem
symbols.summary: Creates or updates a particle system on the linked prim link based on the list of rules. An empty list removes the particle system.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A list of particle system rules and data pairs [rule1, data1, ...], or a ParticleParams dictionary.

symbols.name: ll.LinkPlaySound
symbols.signature: ll.LinkPlaySound(link: number, sound: string | uuid, volume: number, flags: number): ()
symbols.summary: Plays the specified sound on the linked prim link (once or looping) at volume. Only one sound can be attached to a prim at a time; new attachments or calling llStopSound stops previous playback. Controlled by flags.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitwise flags (combination of SOUND_*) controlling the sound playback.

symbols.name: ll.LinkSetSoundQueueing
symbols.summary: Enables or disables sound queuing on the linked prim link. When set to TRUE, sounds will queue and play in sequence.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sound queuing is enabled; if FALSE, it is disabled.

symbols.name: ll.LinkSetSoundRadius
symbols.summary: Limits the audibility radius of attached and triggered scripted sounds to distance radius (in meters) around the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance in meters at which the sounds can be heard.

symbols.name: ll.LinkSitTarget
symbols.signature: ll.LinkSitTarget(link: number, offset: vector, rot: quaternion): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the sit target position (offset) and orientation (rot) for the linked prim link, relative to the prim's own position and rotation. Clear by setting offset to <0.0, 0.0, 0.0>.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset position vector in local prim coordinates.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Rotation relative to the prim's rotation.

symbols.name: ll.LinkStopSound
symbols.summary: Stops the playback of any currently playing attached sound on the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataAvailable
symbols.summary: Returns the number of bytes remaining in the linkset datastore.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataCountFound
symbols.summary: Returns the number of keys in the linkset datastore that match the regular expression pattern.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression (regex) matching the keys to count.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataCountKeys
symbols.summary: Returns the number of keys in the linkset datastore.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataDelete
symbols.summary: Deletes the unprotected key name from the linkset datastore, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the key to delete.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataDeleteFound
symbols.summary: Deletes all keys in the linkset datastore that match the regular expression pattern, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Protected keys are only deleted if their passphrase matches pass. Returns a list [num_deleted, num_failed_protected].

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression (regex) matching the keys to delete.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Optional passphrase required to delete matching protected keys.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataDeleteProtected
symbols.summary: Deletes the protected key name from the linkset datastore using the passphrase pass, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the protected key to delete.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Passphrase required to delete the protected key.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataFindKeys
symbols.signature: ll.LinksetDataFindKeys(pattern: string, start: number, count: number): {string}
symbols.summary: Returns an alphabetically sorted list of up to count keys from the linkset datastore that match the regular expression pattern, starting at index start (returns all matching keys if count < 1).

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression (regex) matching the keys to return.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first matching key to return.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of keys to return (or less than 1 to retrieve all matching keys).

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataListKeys
symbols.summary: Returns an alphabetically sorted list of up to count keys from the linkset datastore, starting at index start (returns all keys if count < 1).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Index of the first key to return.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of keys to return (or less than 1 to retrieve all keys).

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataRead
symbols.summary: Returns the value of the unprotected key name from the linkset datastore. Returns an empty string if the key is not found or is protected.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the key to read.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataReadProtected
symbols.summary: Returns the value of the protected key name from the linkset datastore using the passphrase pass. Returns an empty string if the key is not found or pass does not match.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the protected key to read.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Passphrase required to read the protected key.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataReset
symbols.summary: Deletes all keys from the linkset datastore, triggering a linkset_data event.

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataWrite
symbols.summary: Creates or updates the unprotected key name in the linkset datastore with value, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the key to write.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write to the key (an empty string deletes the key).

symbols.name: ll.LinksetDataWriteProtected
symbols.signature: ll.LinksetDataWriteProtected(name: string, value: string, pass: string): number
symbols.summary: Creates or updates the protected key name in the linkset datastore with value using the passphrase pass, triggering a linkset_data event if the datastore changes. Returns an integer success or failure code.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the protected key to write.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write to the key (an empty string deletes the key).

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: Passphrase used to protect or update the key.

symbols.name: ll.List2CSV
symbols.summary: Returns a string of comma-separated values taken in order from the list src.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to convert.

symbols.name: ll.List2Float
symbols.summary: Returns the float value at index in the list src. Returns 0.0 if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: ll.List2Integer
symbols.summary: Returns the integer value at index in the list src. Returns 0 if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: ll.List2Json
symbols.summary: Converts the list values into a JSON string of the specified type (either a JSON_ARRAY or a JSON_OBJECT). Returns JSON_INVALID if an error is encountered.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: JSON target type (JSON_ARRAY or JSON_OBJECT).

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: List of values to serialize.

symbols.name: ll.List2Key
symbols.summary: Returns the key (UUID) value at index in the list src. Returns a null string/key if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: ll.List2List
symbols.summary: Returns a new list containing the subset of entries from src within the inclusive range specified by the start and end indices. Negative indices count backward from the end.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to slice.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive).

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive).

symbols.name: ll.List2ListSlice
symbols.signature: ll.List2ListSlice(src: {T}, start_index: number, end_index: number, stride: number, slice_index: number): {T}
symbols.summary: Returns a list containing the slice_index'th element of every stride within the inclusive range from start to end in the strided list src. Stride must be a positive integer.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source strided list.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive).

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive).

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

parameters.name: slice_index
parameters.description: Zero-based element index within each stride to extract (negatives count backward from the end of the stride).

symbols.name: ll.List2ListStrided
symbols.signature: ll.List2ListStrided(src: {T}, start_index: number, end_index: number, stride: number): {T}
symbols.summary: Returns a new list containing the first element of every stride in the strided list src within the inclusive range from start to end.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source strided list.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive).

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive).

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

symbols.name: ll.List2Rot
symbols.summary: Returns the rotation value at index in the list src. Returns ZERO_ROTATION if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: ll.List2String
symbols.summary: Returns the string value at index in the list src. Returns an empty string if the index is out of bounds.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: ll.List2Vector
symbols.summary: Returns the vector value at index in the list src. Returns ZERO_VECTOR if the index is out of bounds or if the value cannot be type-cast.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list containing the element of interest.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the entry.

symbols.name: ll.ListFindList
symbols.summary: Returns the integer index of the first instance of list test within the list src (returns nil if not found).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to search within.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: List elements to search for.

symbols.name: ll.ListFindListNext
symbols.signature: ll.ListFindListNext(src: list, test: list, instance: number): number?
symbols.summary: Returns the integer index of the specified instance of list test within the list src (returns nil if not found).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to search within.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: List elements to search for.

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Zero-based occurrence index of the match to find.

symbols.name: ll.ListFindStrided
symbols.signature: ll.ListFindStrided(src: list, test: list, start_index: number, end_index: number, stride: number): number?
symbols.summary: Returns the integer index of the first instance of list test in the strided list src within the range from start to end (stepping through by stride). Returns nil if not found.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to search within.

parameters.name: test
parameters.description: List elements to search for.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index of the range to search.

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index of the range to search.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per stride in the list.

symbols.name: ll.ListInsertList
symbols.summary: Returns a new list containing all elements of dest with the elements of src inserted starting at index start. Does not modify dest itself.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Target destination list.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to insert.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Zero-based index where insertion begins.

symbols.name: ll.ListRandomize
symbols.summary: Returns a randomized copy of the list src by blocks of size stride. If the list length is not perfectly divisible by stride, no randomization occurs.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to randomize.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Size of each randomized block (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

symbols.name: ll.ListReplaceList
symbols.signature: ll.ListReplaceList(dest: {T}, src: {T}, start_index: number, end_index: number): {T}
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the list dest with the inclusive range from start to end removed, and the elements of src inserted in its place at start.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Target destination list.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source list to insert.

parameters.name: start_index
parameters.description: Zero-based start index (inclusive) of the replaced range.

parameters.name: end_index
parameters.description: Zero-based end index (inclusive) of the replaced range.

symbols.name: ll.ListSort
symbols.signature: ll.ListSort(src: {T}, stride: number, ascending: boolean | number): {T}
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the list src, sorted into blocks of stride in ascending order (if ascending is TRUE) or descending order (if FALSE). Only works if the first entry of each block shares the same datatype.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to be sorted.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per block/stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sorts in ascending order; if FALSE, sorts in descending order.

symbols.name: ll.ListSortStrided
symbols.signature: ll.ListSortStrided(src: {T}, stride: number, stride_index: number, ascending: boolean | number): {T}
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the list src sorted into blocks of stride by the element at stride_index in each block. Sorted in ascending order (if ascending is TRUE) or descending order (if FALSE).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List to be sorted.

parameters.name: stride
parameters.description: Number of entries per block/stride (defaults to 1 if less than 1).

parameters.name: stride_index
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the element within each stride to use as the sort key (negatives count backward from the end of the stride).

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sorts in ascending order; if FALSE, sorts in descending order.

symbols.name: ll.ListStatistics
symbols.summary: Returns the numeric result of the statistical aggregate function operation (a LIST_STAT_* constant) on the numeric list src.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: LIST_STAT_* constant of the statistical operation to perform.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: List of numbers to analyze.

symbols.name: ll.Listen
symbols.signature: ll.Listen(channel: number, name: string, id: uuid, msg: string): number
symbols.summary: Creates a listener on channel from name and id for msg. Returns an integer listener handle used to control or remove the listener. Empty strings or NULL_KEY filters do not filter on those parameters.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to listen on. Exact range is -2147483648 to 2147483647.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specific prim name or agent legacy name to filter by (or empty string for no filter).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Specific agent or prim UUID to filter by (or NULL_KEY for no filter).

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Specific chat message string to filter by (or empty string for no filter).

symbols.name: ll.ListenControl
symbols.summary: Enables or disables the listener specified by the integer handle. If active is TRUE, the listener is activated; if FALSE, it is deactivated.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Integer listener handle returned by llListen.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, activates the listener; if FALSE, deactivates it.

symbols.name: ll.ListenRemove
symbols.summary: Completely removes the listener specified by the integer handle.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Integer listener handle returned by llListen to remove.

symbols.name: ll.LoadURL
symbols.signature: ll.LoadURL(avatar: uuid, message: string, url: string): ()
symbols.summary: Shows a dialog box displaying message to the avatar avatar offering to open the specified url. Clicking yes launches the URL in their default web browser.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Text message to display in the dialog box.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Web URL to open.

symbols.name: ll.Log
symbols.summary: Returns natural (base e) logarithm of val. If negative, return 0.0.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to compute the logarithm of.

symbols.name: ll.Log10
symbols.summary: Returns base-10 (common) logarithm of val. If negative, return 0.0.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to compute the logarithm of.

symbols.name: ll.LookAt

parameters.description: Target position vector in region coordinates to look at.

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: Force of rotation (0.0 cancels the tracking; values around half the object's mass are typical).

parameters.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the orientation.

symbols.name: ll.LoopSound

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.LoopSoundMaster
symbols.summary: Plays the attached sound looping indefinitely at the specified volume and declares it a Sync Master, forcing slave sounds to synchronize with it.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.LoopSoundSlave
symbols.summary: Plays the attached sound looping indefinitely at the specified volume, synchronized to the most audible active Sync Master in range.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.MD5String
symbols.summary: Returns a string of 32 hex characters representing the MD5 checksum of src salted with nonce (formatted as ':' + nonce).

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to hash.

parameters.name: nonce
parameters.description: Nonce string used as a salt.

parameters.name: texture

symbols.signature: ll.MakeFountain(particles: number, scale: number, vel: number, lifetime: number, arc: number, bounce: number, texture: string | uuid, offset: vector, bounce_offset: number): ()

parameters.name: texture

symbols.signature: ll.MakeSmoke(particles: number, scale: number, vel: number, lifetime: number, arc: number, texture: string | uuid, offset: vector): ()
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Generates smoke-like particles. Use llParticleSystem instead.

parameters.name: offset

symbols.name: ll.ModPow
