symbols.summary: Returns base raised to the power exponent, modulo modulus (i.e., (b^e)%m). All inputs are wrapped to unsigned 32-bit integer range [0..4294967295]. Output is wrapped to signed 32-bit integer range [-2147483648..2147483647]. Will never overflow, unlike (b^e), which can overflow to inf.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: 32-bit unsigned integer base.

parameters.name: exponent
parameters.description: 32-bit unsigned integer exponent.

parameters.name: modulus
parameters.description: 32-bit unsigned integer modulus.

symbols.name: ll.ModifyLand
symbols.summary: Modifies the terrain using the specified land action and brush size (0, 1, or 2, corresponding to 2m x 2m, 4m x 4m, or 8m x 8m).

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: LAND_* action flag to perform (e.g., LAND_LEVEL, LAND_RAISE, LAND_LOWER, LAND_SMOOTH, LAND_NOISE, or LAND_REVERT).

parameters.name: brush
parameters.description: Brush size (0, 1, or 2, representing 2m x 2m, 4m x 4m, or 8m x 8m).

symbols.name: ll.MoveToTarget
symbols.summary: Critically damps the physical object's motion to position target in tau seconds. Setting tau to 0.0 stops the critical damping; recommended tau values are greater than 0.2.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target position vector in region coordinates.

parameters.name: tau
parameters.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the movement.

symbols.name: ll.Name2Key
symbols.summary: Requests the key (UUID) of the avatar name in the current region. Returns NULL_KEY if no matching agent is present. Formats are 'First Last' or 'first.last' (assumes 'Resident' if last name is omitted; case-insensitive).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the avatar (e.g., 'First Last' or 'first.last').

symbols.name: ll.NavigateTo
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to navigate to the position pos (located in the current or adjacent regions) using the parameters specified in options.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Destination position vector in region coordinates.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of parameters to configure pathfinding behavior (currently only FORCE_DIRECT_PATH is supported).

symbols.name: ll.OffsetTexture
symbols.signature: ll.OffsetTexture(u: number, v: number, face: number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the texture horizontal (u) and vertical (v) offsets for the chosen face. If face is ALL_SIDES, offsets all faces.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Horizontal (U) offset, typically in the interval [-1.0, 1.0].

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Vertical (V) offset, typically in the interval [-1.0, 1.0].

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.OpenFloater
symbols.signature: ll.OpenFloater(floater_name: string, url: string, params: list): number
symbols.summary: Opens the specified viewer floater_name loaded with url and configured via params. Returns an integer error code, or 0 if successful.

parameters.name: floater_name
parameters.description: Identifier string of the viewer floater to open.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL to load within the opened floater.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Options or parameters to apply to the opened floater.

symbols.name: ll.OpenRemoteDataChannel
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Creates a channel to listen for incoming XML-RPC calls, triggering a remote_data event with the channel ID once available.

symbols.name: ll.Ord
symbols.summary: Returns the ordinal (Unicode copepoint integer) of the character at index in the string val. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Source string.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Codepoint index of the character to convert. Supports negative indexing.

symbols.name: ll.OverMyLand
symbols.summary: Returns TRUE if the avatar or object specified by key id is over land owned by the script owner, or FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to check.

symbols.name: ll.OwnerSay
symbols.summary: Sends the chat message msg privately to the object owner (the owner must be currently in the same region for the message to be received).

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to send to the object owner.

symbols.name: ll.ParcelMediaCommandList
symbols.summary: Controls the playback of movies and other multimedia resources on a parcel or for an agent, using the PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* settings specified in commandList.

parameters.name: commandList
parameters.description: A list containing integer PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* flags and their corresponding parameters.

symbols.name: ll.ParcelMediaQuery
symbols.summary: Queries the media properties of the parcel containing the script, returning a list of values in the order requested by query. Only works if the object is owned by the landowner or deeded to the land's group.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A list of PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* attributes to query.

symbols.name: ll.ParseString2List
symbols.summary: Breaks the string src into a list of substrings, discarding any separators, keeping spacers, and omitting any empty null values. separators and spacers accept up to 8 string entries each.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to parse.

parameters.name: separators
parameters.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing separators to be discarded.

parameters.name: spacers
parameters.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing spacers to be preserved in the list.

symbols.name: ll.ParseStringKeepNulls
symbols.summary: Breaks the string src into a list of substrings, discarding separators and keeping spacers, while preserving empty null values (unlike llParseString2List). separators and spacers accept up to 8 string entries each.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to parse.

parameters.name: separators
parameters.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing separators to be discarded.

parameters.name: spacers
parameters.description: A list of up to 8 strings representing spacers to be preserved in the list.

symbols.name: ll.ParticleSystem
symbols.summary: Creates or updates a particle system on the prim containing the script based on rules. An empty list removes the particle system.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A list of particle system rules and data pairs [rule1, data1, ...].

symbols.name: ll.PassCollisions
symbols.summary: Sets the pass-collisions attribute. If pass is TRUE, collision events are passed from child prims to the root; if FALSE (default), they only trigger events in the affected child prim.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: A PASS_* flag (e.g., PASS_ALWAYS, PASS_IF_NOT_HANDLED, or PASS_NEVER).

symbols.name: ll.PassTouches
symbols.summary: Sets the pass-touches attribute. If pass is TRUE, touch events are passed from child prims to the root; if FALSE (default), they only trigger events in the affected child prim.

parameters.name: pass
parameters.description: A PASS_* flag (e.g., PASS_ALWAYS, PASS_IF_NOT_HANDLED, or PASS_NEVER).

symbols.name: ll.PatrolPoints
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to patrol sequentially through the coordinates specified in patrolPoints, configured by options.

parameters.name: patrolPoints
parameters.description: A list of at least two position vectors representing the patrol path.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of PATROL_* flags and parameters to configure the patrol behavior.

symbols.name: ll.PlaySound
symbols.summary: Plays the specified sound once at volume, attached to the object. Only one sound can be attached to a prim at a time; new sounds or calling llStopSound stops previous playback. A second call with the same sound adjusts the volume without restarting it.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.PlaySoundSlave
symbols.summary: Plays the attached sound once at volume, synchronized to the next loop point of the most audible active Sync Master.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.Pow
symbols.summary: Returns base raised to the power exponent. If result is imaginary, returns NaN.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Base number.

parameters.name: exponent
parameters.description: Exponent number.

symbols.name: ll.PreloadSound
symbols.summary: Causes nearby viewers in range to preload the specified sound from the object's inventory to prevent playback delays.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of the sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

symbols.name: ll.Pursue
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to pursue and chase target, configured by the parameters specified in options.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to pursue.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options to configure pursuit behavior.

symbols.name: ll.PushObject
symbols.signature: ll.PushObject(target: uuid, impulse: vector, ang_impulse: vector, is_local: boolean | number): ()
symbols.summary: Applies physical impulse (force) and ang_impulse (rotational force) to the specified target avatar or object.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the target avatar or object in the same region.

parameters.name: impulse
parameters.description: Linear impulse vector representing the direction and force of the push.

parameters.name: ang_impulse
parameters.description: Angular impulse vector representing the rotational force.

parameters.name: is_local
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, forces are applied relative to the target's local axes; if FALSE, relative to region axes.

symbols.name: ll.ReadKeyValue
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction to read the value associated with key k in the experience. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event. Fails with XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND if the key does not exist.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Key of the key-value pair to read.

symbols.name: ll.RefreshPrimURL
symbols.summary: Legacy function intended to reload the web page displayed on the prim's faces (currently non-functional).

symbols.name: ll.RegionSay
symbols.summary: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts listening on channel Channel within the region. PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) cannot be used, so, only scripts can receive the message.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value except zero) to chat the message on.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to broadcast.

symbols.name: ll.RegionSayTo
symbols.signature: ll.RegionSayTo(target: uuid, channel: number, msg: string): ()
symbols.summary: Sends the message msg on Channel privately to the targeted agent or object (if within the region). If target is an agent and channel is non-zero, the message can also be heard by any attachments worn by the avatar.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the target agent or prim in the same region.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to chat the message on.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to send.

symbols.name: ll.ReleaseCamera
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Intended to return camera control back to the avatar (use llClearCameraParams instead).

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: ll.ReleaseControls
symbols.summary: Stops taking inputs (previously acquired via llTakeControls) from the avatar, dequeuing any remaining control events and revoking the PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS permission.

symbols.name: ll.ReleaseURL
symbols.summary: Releases the specified url (previously obtained via llRequestURL), rendering it no longer usable.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL string to release.

symbols.name: ll.RemoteDataReply
symbols.signature: ll.RemoteDataReply(channel: uuid, message_id: uuid, sdata: string, idata: number): ()
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Sends an XML-RPC reply on channel to message_id with payload string sdata and integer idata.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: XML-RPC channel ID.

parameters.name: message_id
parameters.description: XML-RPC message ID.

parameters.name: sdata
parameters.description: String payload data to reply with.

parameters.name: idata
parameters.description: Integer payload data to reply with.

symbols.name: ll.RemoteDataSetRegion
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Used with XML-RPC to reregister remote data channels if the object moves to another region.

symbols.name: ll.RemoteLoadScriptPin
symbols.signature: ll.RemoteLoadScriptPin(target: uuid, script: string, pin: number, running: boolean | number, start_param: number): ()
symbols.summary: Copies the script into target, setting it running (if running is TRUE) with the start_param, provided the script owner has modify permissions on target and target's PIN matches pin (set via llSetRemoteScriptAccessPin).

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: UUID of the target prim in the same region.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: pin
parameters.description: Integer PIN code (must match the PIN set on the ObjectID via llSetRemoteScriptAccessPin).

parameters.name: running
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sets the copied script to run immediately; if FALSE, leaves it stopped.

parameters.name: start_param
parameters.description: Integer start parameter passed to the copied script (readable via llGetStartParameter).

symbols.name: ll.RemoveFromLandBanList
symbols.summary: Removes the specified avatar from the land parcel's ban list.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to remove.

symbols.name: ll.RemoveFromLandPassList
symbols.summary: Removes the specified avatar from the land parcel's pass/access list.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to remove.

symbols.name: ll.RemoveInventory
symbols.summary: Permanently deletes the named inventory item from the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory to remove.

symbols.name: ll.RemoveVehicleFlags
symbols.summary: Disables the specified vehicle flags (sets them to FALSE) using the bitwise mask flags.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: A bitwise mask of VEHICLE_FLAG_* constants to disable.

symbols.name: ll.ReplaceAgentEnvironment
symbols.signature: ll.ReplaceAgentEnvironment(agent_id: uuid, transition: number, environment: string | uuid): number
symbols.summary: Replaces the region and parcel environment seen by the specified agent_id as part of an experience, transitioning the settings over transition seconds. Passing NULL_KEY or an empty string for environment restores defaults.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: UUID of an agent in the region participating in the experience.

parameters.name: transition
parameters.description: Duration in seconds over which to transition to the new environment.

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Name of an environmental setting in inventory, or its asset UUID (or empty string/NULL_KEY to clear).

symbols.name: ll.ReplaceEnvironment
symbols.signature: ll.ReplaceEnvironment(position: vector, environment: string | uuid, track_no: number, day_length: number, day_offset: number): number
symbols.summary: Replaces the environment on the parcel containing position (or the entire region if position is <-1.0, -1.0, -1.0>) for the specified track_no. Modifies day_length and day_offset if specified. Requires edit permissions on the parcel or estate management rights.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position vector of the target parcel (the Z component is ignored; use <-1.0, -1.0, -1.0> for the entire region).

parameters.name: environment
parameters.description: Name of an environmental setting in inventory, or its asset UUID (or empty string/NULL_KEY to clear).

parameters.name: track_no
parameters.description: The elevation track to change (0: water, 1: ground, 2: 1000m, 3: 2000m, 4: 3000m, -1: all tracks).

parameters.name: day_length
parameters.description: Day cycle length in seconds (-1 to leave unchanged).

parameters.name: day_offset
parameters.description: Day cycle offset in seconds from UTC (-1 to leave unchanged).

symbols.name: ll.ReplaceSubString
symbols.signature: ll.ReplaceSubString(src: string, pattern: string, replacement_pattern: string, count: number): string
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of src with count occurrences of pattern replaced by replacement_pattern. Setting count to 0 replaces all occurrences; positive counts process left-to-right, while negative counts process right-to-left.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Original source string to search.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Substring pattern to find and replace.

parameters.name: replacement_pattern
parameters.description: New substring that replaces the pattern.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Maximum number of replacements to make (0 for all, positive for left-to-right, negative for right-to-left).

symbols.name: ll.RequestAgentData
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the specified data category (DATA_*) about the agent id. Triggers a dataserver event with the results and returns a key query handle.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the agent.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: DATA_* category flag of the requested information.

symbols.name: ll.RequestDisplayName
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the display name of the agent specified by id, triggering a dataserver event with the results. The agent does not need to be online or in the region. Returns a key query handle.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to query.

symbols.name: ll.RequestExperiencePermissions
symbols.summary: Requests permission from the specified agent to participate in the experience. These permissions are persistent and apply grid-wide across all scripts in the experience, automatically triggering experience_permissions or experience_permissions_denied.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the agent to request permissions from.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Deprecated parameter (no longer used).

symbols.name: ll.RequestInventoryData
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests data for the named inventory item, triggering a dataserver event. Currently, only landmark items are supported (which return local region coordinates). Returns a key query handle.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: ll.RequestPermissions
symbols.summary: Requests permissions (a bitfield specified by permissions) from the agent in the same region, calling run_time_permissions if granted. This call does not pause script execution.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the agent in the same region.

parameters.name: permissions
parameters.description: Bitfield containing the PERMISSION_* constants to request.

symbols.name: ll.RequestSecureURL
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests one secure HTTPS (SSL, port 12043) URL for use by this object, triggering an http_request event. Returns a key query handle.

symbols.name: ll.RequestSimulatorData
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests data (using a DATA_SIM_* constant) about the region. Triggers a dataserver event and returns a key query handle.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Case-sensitive region name.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: DATA_SIM_* flag of the requested simulator data.

symbols.name: ll.RequestURL
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests one HTTP URL for use by this script, triggering an http_request event. Returns a key query handle.

symbols.name: ll.RequestUserKey
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the Agent ID key (UUID) for the agent specified by their current or historical username, returning NULL_KEY if not found. Returns a key query handle for the dataserver event.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Current or historical username of the avatar to resolve.

symbols.name: ll.RequestUsername
symbols.summary: Asynchronously requests the unique single-word username of the agent identified by id, triggering a dataserver event. The agent does not need to be online or in the region. Returns a key query handle.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to query.

symbols.name: ll.ResetAnimationOverride
symbols.summary: Resets the animation override for anim_state to its default value (use 'ALL' to reset all states). Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS permission.

parameters.name: anim_state
parameters.description: Animation state string (or 'ALL') to reset.

symbols.name: ll.ResetLandBanList
symbols.summary: Removes all blocked residents from the land parcel's ban list.

symbols.name: ll.ResetLandPassList
symbols.summary: Removes all residents from the land parcel's access/pass list.

symbols.name: ll.ResetOtherScript
symbols.summary: Resets the named script name in the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Name of the target script in the prim's inventory.

symbols.name: ll.ResetScript
symbols.summary: Resets the current script.

symbols.name: ll.ReturnObjectsByID
symbols.summary: Returns objects specified by the list of UUIDs objects to their owners. Requires the PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS permission, and the script owner must own the parcel or be an estate manager/region owner.

parameters.name: objects
parameters.description: A list of object UUID keys to return.

symbols.name: ll.ReturnObjectsByOwner
symbols.summary: Returns objects owned by owner within the specified scope (parcel, parcel owner, or region). Requires the PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS permission, and the script owner must own the parcel or be an estate manager/region owner.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar or group whose objects will be returned.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: OBJECT_RETURN_* scope flag (such as OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL, OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL_OWNER, or OBJECT_RETURN_REGION).

symbols.name: ll.RezAtRoot
symbols.signature: ll.RezAtRoot(item: string, pos: vector, vel: vector, rot: quaternion, start_param: number): ()
symbols.summary: Instantiates the named inventory object with the root prim at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot, passing start_param as the on_rez start parameter. The vel parameter is ignored if the rezzed object is non-physical.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates where the root of the object will be placed.

parameters.name: vel
parameters.description: Initial velocity vector for the rezzed object.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Initial rotation of the rezzed object.

parameters.name: start_param
parameters.description: Start parameter passed to the rezzed object's on_rez event (accessible via llGetStartParameter).

symbols.name: ll.RezObject
symbols.signature: ll.RezObject(item: string, pos: vector, vel: vector, rot: quaternion, start_param: number): ()
symbols.summary: Instantiates the named inventory object with the bounding box centered at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot, passing param as the on_rez start parameter. The vel parameter is ignored if the rezzed object is non-physical.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates where the center of the object will be placed.

parameters.name: vel
parameters.description: Initial velocity vector (maximum magnitude ~200m/s).

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Initial rotation of the rezzed object.

parameters.name: start_param
parameters.description: Start parameter passed to the rezzed object's on_rez event (accessible via llGetStartParameter).

symbols.name: ll.RezObjectWithParams
symbols.summary: Instantiates the named inventory object (defaulting to the rezzing prim's position unless REZ_POS is specified) using the initial set of parameters specified in options. Returns the key of the rezzed object, or a blank key on failure.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the object in the prim's inventory to rez.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of REZ_* options to configure the rezzed object's attributes.

symbols.name: ll.Rot2Angle
symbols.summary: Returns the angle, in radians, that q rotates.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Rotation to evaluate.

symbols.name: ll.Rot2Axis
symbols.summary: Returns the unit vector axis that q rotates around.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Rotation to evaluate.

symbols.name: ll.Rot2Euler
symbols.summary: Returns a vector of Euler angles (roll, pitch, yaw) of q. The angles will be in radians.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Rotation to convert.

symbols.name: ll.Rot2Fwd
symbols.summary: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive X (forward) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <1, 0, 0> * q.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Rotation to convert.

symbols.name: ll.Rot2Left
symbols.summary: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Y (left) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <0, 1, 0> * q.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Rotation to convert.

symbols.name: ll.Rot2Up
symbols.summary: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Z (up) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to <0, 0, 1> * q.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Rotation to convert.

symbols.name: ll.RotBetween
symbols.summary: Returns the shortest-path quaternion that rotates start_vec onto end_vec.

parameters.name: start_vec
parameters.description: Starting vector.

parameters.name: end_vec
parameters.description: Ending vector.

symbols.name: ll.RotLookAt
symbols.signature: ll.RotLookAt(target_direction: quaternion, strength: number, damping: number): ()
symbols.summary: Causes the object to smoothly rotate to target_direction with a force defined by strength and damping. A strength of 0.0 cancels the rotation target. Rotation is maintained until stopped with llStopLookAt.

parameters.name: target_direction
parameters.description: Target rotation to align the object with.

parameters.name: strength
parameters.description: Force of rotation (0.0 cancels the tracking; values around half the object's mass are typical).

parameters.name: damping
parameters.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the rotation.

symbols.name: ll.RotTarget
symbols.summary: Registers the rotation rot with a leeway tolerance error (in radians) as a target, triggering at_rot_target and not_at_rot_target events. Returns an integer handle to unregister the target via llRotTargetRemove.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Target rotation to track.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Tolerance angle in radians defining when the target rotation is considered reached.

symbols.name: ll.RotTargetRemove
symbols.summary: Removes the rotational target specified by the integer handle registered with llRotTarget.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Integer target handle returned by llRotTarget to remove.

symbols.name: ll.RotateTexture
symbols.summary: Sets the texture rotation of face to the specified angle (in radians). If face is ALL_SIDES, rotates the texture on all faces.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: Rotation angle expressed in radians.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.Round
symbols.summary: Returns val rounded to the nearest integer. Halfway values are rounded toward infinity.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Number to round.

symbols.name: ll.SHA1String
symbols.summary: Returns a string of 40 hex characters representing the SHA-1 security hash of src.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to hash.

symbols.name: ll.SHA256String
symbols.summary: Returns a string of 64 hex characters representing the SHA-256 security hash of src.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to hash.

symbols.name: ll.SameGroup
symbols.summary: Returns TRUE if the agent or object specified by uuid is in the same region (simulator) and shares the same active group as the prim containing the script; returns FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or prim to check.

symbols.name: ll.Say
symbols.summary: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("chat_range"), which is 20m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to chat the message on.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to broadcast.

symbols.name: ll.ScaleByFactor
symbols.summary: Attempts to uniformly resize the entire object by scaling_factor, maintaining size-position ratios of the prims. Fails if the linkset is physical, a pathfinding character, in keyframed motion, would exceed prim scale/linkability limits, or would overflow parcel capacity.

parameters.name: scaling_factor
parameters.description: Multiplier scale factor to apply to the prim sizes and their local positions.

symbols.name: ll.ScaleTexture
symbols.signature: ll.ScaleTexture(u: number, v: number, face: number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the diffuse texture horizontal u and vertical v scales (repeats) on the specified face of the prim. Setting face to ALL_SIDES updates all sides. Negative scale values flip the texture.

parameters.name: u
parameters.description: Horizontal (U) texture repeats scale value, in the interval [-100.0, 100.0].

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Vertical (V) texture repeats scale value, in the interval [-100.0, 100.0].

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.ScriptDanger
symbols.summary: Returns TRUE if the vector position pos is over public land, sandbox land, land restricting edit/build permissions, or land that disables outside scripts.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates to check.

symbols.name: ll.ScriptProfiler
symbols.summary: Enables or disables the script's profiling state using flags (supports PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY on Mono, or PROFILE_NONE). Active profiling can significantly reduce script performance.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: PROFILE_* flag (such as PROFILE_NONE or PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY) to set the profiling state.

symbols.name: ll.SendRemoteData
symbols.signature: ll.SendRemoteData(channel: uuid, dest: string, idata: number, sdata: string): uuid
symbols.summary: Deprecated. Sends an XML-RPC request to dest on channel, containing the channel ID as a string, integer idata, and string sdata. Returns a key representing the message_id.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: XML-RPC channel ID.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: Destination XML-RPC URL or server.

parameters.name: idata
parameters.description: Integer payload data.

parameters.name: sdata
parameters.description: String payload data.

symbols.name: ll.Sensor
symbols.signature: ll.Sensor(name: string, id: uuid, type: number, radius: number, arc: number): ()
symbols.summary: Performs a single scan from the prim's forward vector for name and id of type within radius meters and arc radians. Results trigger a sensor or no_sensor event. Passing empty filters (blank name, 0 type, or NULL_KEY id) disables that filter.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specific object or avatar name to filter for (or empty string for no filter).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to filter by (or NULL_KEY for no filter).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Integer bitfield type mask containing AGENT, AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, AGENT_BY_USERNAME, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, or SCRIPTED (0 for no filter).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance in meters to scan (range [0.0, 96.0]).

parameters.name: arc
parameters.description: Maximum angle in radians relative to the local X-axis to scan (range [0.0, PI]).

symbols.name: ll.SensorRemove
symbols.summary: Removes the periodic sensor previously configured by llSensorRepeat.

symbols.name: ll.SensorRepeat
symbols.signature: ll.SensorRepeat(name: string, id: uuid, type: number, radius: number, arc: number, rate: number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets up a repeating periodic scan every rate seconds for name and id of type within radius meters and arc radians of the forward vector. Results trigger sensor or no_sensor events.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specific object or avatar name to filter for (or empty string for no filter).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the group, avatar, or object to filter by (or NULL_KEY for no filter).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Integer bitfield type mask containing AGENT, AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, AGENT_BY_USERNAME, ACTIVE, PASSIVE, or SCRIPTED (0 for no filter).

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance in meters to scan (range [0.0, 96.0]).

parameters.name: arc
parameters.description: Maximum angle in radians relative to the local X-axis to scan (range [0.0, PI]).

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Interval in seconds between repeated scans.

symbols.name: ll.SetAgentEnvironment
symbols.signature: ll.SetAgentEnvironment(agent_id: uuid, transition: number, params: list): number
symbols.summary: Sets an individual agent's environmental settings using the attributes in params over a duration of transition seconds. Must be used as part of an experience; passing an empty list removes overrides.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: UUID of the agent participating in the experience.

parameters.name: transition
parameters.description: Transition duration in seconds.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of environmental parameters to apply.

symbols.name: ll.SetAgentRot
symbols.summary: Sets the rotation of the avatar to rot, controlled by flags.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Target rotation to turn the avatar to face.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to configure the rotation behavior.

symbols.name: ll.SetAlpha
symbols.summary: Sets the diffuse texture alpha (opacity) of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, applies to all faces. Values are clamped between 0.1 and 1.0 (where 1.0 is fully opaque).

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid; clamped to a minimum of 0.1).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetAngularVelocity
symbols.summary: Sets the angular velocity of a physical object to initial_omega (mass-independent). If local is TRUE, applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, applied in global coordinates. Has no effect on non-physical objects.

parameters.name: initial_omega
parameters.description: Angular velocity vector to apply (in radians per second).

parameters.name: is_local
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, initial_omega is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

symbols.name: ll.SetAnimationOverride
symbols.summary: Overrides the default animation for anim_state with anim (which must be in the object's inventory or a built-in animation). Requires the PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS permission.

parameters.name: anim_state
parameters.description: Animation state to override.

parameters.name: anim
parameters.description: Name of an animation in the prim's inventory, or a built-in animation name.

symbols.name: ll.SetBuoyancy
symbols.summary: Sets the buoyancy of a physical object (requires physics to be enabled). A value of 0.0 offers no buoyancy, < 1.0 sinks, 1.0 counteracts gravity, and > 1.0 rises.

parameters.name: buoyancy
parameters.description: Float buoyancy value to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetCameraAtOffset
symbols.summary: Sets the target offset vector (in local coordinates) that a seated avatar's camera will look at.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

symbols.name: ll.SetCameraEyeOffset
symbols.summary: Sets the eye offset vector (in local coordinates) where a seated avatar's camera is positioned.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

symbols.name: ll.SetCameraParams
symbols.summary: Sets multiple camera parameters simultaneously using the list of rules. Requires the PERMISSION_CONTROL_CAMERA runtime permission.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A strided list of rules and data pairs configuring the camera.

symbols.name: ll.SetClickAction
symbols.summary: Sets the action (a CLICK_ACTION_* flag) performed when an avatar left-clicks the prim.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: CLICK_ACTION_* flag representing the action to apply.

symbols.name: ll.SetColor
symbols.summary: Sets the Blinn-Phong diffuse RGB color of face. If face is ALL_SIDES, applies the color to all faces.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetContentType
symbols.summary: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent HTTP server responses (via llHTTPResponse) for request_id using the specified content_type (a CONTENT_TYPE_* constant).

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: Unique key identifying the incoming HTTP request.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.description: CONTENT_TYPE_* constant representing the Internet media type to use.

symbols.name: ll.SetDamage
symbols.summary: Sets the amount of damage delivered when this object hits an avatar. The object is immediately destroyed upon inflicting damage, and no collision event is triggered.

parameters.name: damage
parameters.description: Float damage value to set (range -100.0 for full heal to 100.0 for instant kill).

symbols.name: ll.SetEnvironment
symbols.summary: Overrides the environmental settings at position for a parcel (or region if position is <-1.0, -1.0, z>) using the parameters in params. Passing an empty params list removes previous overrides.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position vector in region coordinates to specify the target parcel, or <-1.0, -1.0, z> for the entire region (where z specifies the sky track, or -1 for all tracks).

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of environmental attributes and values to apply (or empty to clear).

symbols.name: ll.SetForce
symbols.summary: Applies a constant linear force to a physical object. If local is TRUE, force is applied relative to local coordinates; if FALSE, applied relative to region coordinates.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Directional force vector to apply.

parameters.name: is_local
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, force is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

symbols.name: ll.SetForceAndTorque
symbols.signature: ll.SetForceAndTorque(force: vector, torque: vector, is_local: boolean | number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets both the constant linear force and constant torque acting on a physical object. If local is TRUE, forces are applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, in global coordinates.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Directional linear force vector.

parameters.name: torque
parameters.description: Torque rotational force vector.

parameters.name: is_local
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, force and torque are treated as local vectors; if FALSE, as global region vectors.

symbols.name: ll.SetGroundTexture
symbols.summary: Changes the painted terrain textures on the region based on changes. The script owner must have estate management rights. Returns an integer status.

parameters.name: changes
parameters.description: A list of terrain detail properties and values to change.

symbols.name: ll.SetHoverHeight
symbols.signature: ll.SetHoverHeight(height: number, water: boolean | number, tau: number): ()
symbols.summary: Critically damps the physical object's vertical movement to hover at height (above ground, or above water if water is TRUE) in tau seconds. Do not use with vehicles; call llStopHover to cancel.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Distance to hover above the ground or water.

parameters.name: water
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, hovers above water too; if FALSE, water is ignored.

parameters.name: tau
parameters.description: Timescale in seconds to critically damp the movement.

symbols.name: ll.SetInventoryPermMask
symbols.signature: ll.SetInventoryPermMask(item: string, group: number, flags: number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the specified item's permission flags for the specified group.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Name of the item in the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to set.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitfield of permissions (PERM_* flags) to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetKeyframedMotion
symbols.summary: Smoothly moves a non-physical object between the positions, orientations, and times specified in the keyframes list, configured via options. Collisions with keyframed objects are ignored. An empty keyframes list terminates the motion.

parameters.name: keyframes
parameters.description: A strided list of the form [vector position, rotation orientation, float time] representing sequential relative keyframes (minimum time is 1/9s).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of options (KFM_* constants) to modify playback behavior.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkAlpha
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkAlpha(link: number, alpha: number, face: number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the Blinn-Phong alpha (transparency) of face on the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkCamera
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkCamera(link: number, eye: vector, at: vector): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the camera eye position offset eye and looking-at position offset at for avatars who sit on the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: eye
parameters.description: Eye offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Look-at offset position vector in local coordinates relative to the prim.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkColor
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkColor(link: number, color: vector, face: number): ()
symbols.summary: Sets the Blinn-Phong diffuse RGB color of face on the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkGLTFOverrides
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkGLTFOverrides(link: number, face: number, params: list): ()
symbols.summary: Sets or removes individual GLTF override parameters specified by params on face of the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A list of overrides and their corresponding values to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkMedia
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkMedia(link: number, face: number, params: list): number
symbols.summary: Sets the media parameters specified by params on face of the linked prim link without a script delay. Returns an integer STATUS_* flag detailing success or failure.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A set of property-value pairs (in no particular order) specifying media parameters, or a PrimMediaParams dictionary.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkPrimitiveParams
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast instead). Sets primitive parameters for the linked prim link according to rules.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_* rules and data to apply.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast
symbols.summary: Sets primitive parameters for the linked prim link according to rules with no built-in script sleep delay.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_* rules and data to apply.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkRenderMaterial
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkRenderMaterial(link: number, material: string | uuid, face: number): ()
symbols.summary: Applies material (UUID or inventory name) to face of the linked prim link. Note: This clears most PRIM_GLTF_* properties on the face except for repeats, offsets, and rotation.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Name of a material in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkSitFlags
symbols.summary: Sets the sit target flags for the linked prim link inside the linkset.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: A bitfield of sit flags (SIT_FLAG_*) to apply.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkTexture
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkTexture(link: number, texture: string | uuid, face: number): ()
symbols.summary: Applies texture (UUID or inventory name) to face of the linked prim link.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetLinkTextureAnim
symbols.signature: ll.SetLinkTextureAnim(link: number, mode: number, face: number, sizex: number, sizey: number, start: number, length: number, rate: number): ()
symbols.summary: Animates the texture on face of the linked prim link by setting the scale and offset according to mode. Parameters sizex/sizey define frames, start defines the start frame/angle, length defines duration, and rate defines playback speed.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number (1 for root, >1 for children) or a LINK_* flag to animate.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Bitfield of texture animation mode flags (ANIM_ON, LOOP, etc.).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

parameters.name: sizex
parameters.description: Number of horizontal frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

parameters.name: sizey
parameters.description: Number of vertical frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start frame number (or radians for ROTATE).

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of frames to display (or radians for ROTATE).

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate in frames per second (or radians/sec for ROTATE, UV coords/sec for SMOOTH). Must not be zero.

symbols.name: ll.SetLocalRot
symbols.summary: Sets the rotation of a child prim relative to its root prim using rot.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Local rotation to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetObjectDesc
symbols.summary: Sets the description of the prim containing the script to description (limited to 127 characters).

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New description string (up to 127 characters).

symbols.name: ll.SetObjectName
symbols.summary: Sets the name of the prim containing the script to name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: New name string.

symbols.name: ll.SetObjectPermMask
symbols.summary: Sets the scripts's object's permission flags for the specified group.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: MASK_* group (e.g., MASK_BASE, MASK_OWNER, MASK_GROUP, MASK_EVERYONE, or MASK_NEXT) to set.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Bitfield of permissions (PERM_* flags) to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetParcelForSale
symbols.signature: ll.SetParcelForSale(ForSale: boolean | number, Options: list): number
symbols.summary: Sets the parcel the object is on for sale. If ForSale is TRUE, puts the land up for sale using Options (price, buyer, objects included). Setting ForSale to FALSE removes the parcel from sale. Requires parcel ownership and the PERMISSION_PRIVILEGED_LAND_ACCESS permission. Returns an error code or 0 if successful.

parameters.name: ForSale
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, puts the parcel up for sale; if FALSE, removes it from sale.

parameters.name: Options
parameters.description: A list of options to configure the sale (e.g., price, authorized buyer, and object inclusion).

symbols.name: ll.SetParcelMusicURL
symbols.summary: Sets the streaming audio (music) URL for the parcel containing the object. The object owner must match the landowner or land group.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Streaming audio URL string.

symbols.name: ll.SetPayPrice
symbols.summary: Suggests default amounts for the pay text input field price and the four payment dialog quick_pay_buttons when an avatar pays this object.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Default price integer shown in the text field (can accept PAY_* constants or positive values).

parameters.name: quick_pay_buttons
parameters.description: A list of four integer values or PAY_* constants specifying the button payment choices.

symbols.name: ll.SetPhysicsMaterial
symbols.signature: ll.SetPhysicsMaterial(mask: number, gravity_multiplier: number, restitution: number, friction: number, density: number): ()
symbols.summary: Configures the physical characteristics of an object. The mask bitfield specifies which of the other parameters (gravity_multiplier, restitution, friction, or density) should be applied to the object.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Bitwise mask combination specifying which of the floats (DENSITY, FRICTION, RESTITUTION, or GRAVITY_MULTIPLIER) to apply.

parameters.name: gravity_multiplier
parameters.description: Gravity multiplier float value (range [-1.0, +28.0], default is 1.0).

parameters.name: restitution
parameters.description: Elasticity restitution float value (range [0.0, 1.0]).

parameters.name: friction
parameters.description: Friction coefficient float value (range [0.0, 255.0]).

parameters.name: density
parameters.description: Density float value in kg/m³ (range [1.0, 22587.0]).

symbols.name: ll.SetPos
symbols.summary: Moves the non-physical object or prim toward the vector pos (up to 10m). If called in a child prim, pos is treated as root-relative; if called from the root prim, the entire object is moved.

parameters.name: pos
parameters.description: Position vector to move to (in region coordinates, or local coordinates if in a child prim).

symbols.name: ll.SetPrimMediaParams
symbols.summary: Sets the media parameters specified by params on the designated face of the prim. Returns an integer STATUS_* flag detailing success or failure.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number (side) of the prim.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: A set of property-value pairs (in no particular order) specifying media parameters.

symbols.name: ll.SetPrimURL
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llSetPrimMediaParams instead). Updates the URL displayed on the prim's faces.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Web URL to display.

symbols.name: ll.SetPrimitiveParams
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast instead). Sets the prim's attributes according to rules.

parameters.name: rules
parameters.description: A list of PRIM_* rules and data to apply.

symbols.name: ll.SetRegionPos
symbols.summary: Tries to move the entire object so that its root prim is within 0.1m of the vector position (underground positions are set to ground level). Returns TRUE on success or FALSE on failure.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Target position vector in region coordinates (can cross up to 10m over a region border).

symbols.name: ll.SetRemoteScriptAccessPin
symbols.summary: Sets the prim's remote script access PIN to pin (a non-zero value enables loading via llRemoteLoadScriptPin, while zero disables it).

parameters.name: pin
parameters.description: Integer PIN code (non-zero enables, zero disables).

symbols.name: ll.SetRenderMaterial
symbols.summary: Applies material (UUID or inventory name) to face of the prim. Note: This clears most PRIM_GLTF_* properties on the face except for repeats, offsets, and rotation.

parameters.name: material
parameters.description: Name of a material in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetRot
symbols.summary: Sets the rotation of the prim to rot. If in a child prim, rot is treated as root-relative; if in the root prim of a non-physical object, rotates the entire object.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Target rotation.

symbols.name: ll.SetScale
symbols.summary: Sets the physical scale (dimensions) of the prim containing the script to size.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Target size vector.

symbols.name: ll.SetScriptState
symbols.summary: Sets the running state of the named script in the prim's inventory. If running is TRUE, the script is enabled; if FALSE, it is disabled.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Name of the script in the prim's inventory.

parameters.name: running
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables the script; if FALSE, disables it.

symbols.name: ll.SetSitText
symbols.summary: Displays the string text instead of 'Sit' (or 'Sit Here') in the viewer's right-click context menu.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Context menu text to display.

symbols.name: ll.SetSoundQueueing
symbols.summary: Sets whether attached sounds wait for the current sound to end before playing (enables queuing if queue is TRUE, disables if FALSE). The queue is one level deep.

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, sound queuing is enabled; if FALSE, it is disabled.

symbols.name: ll.SetSoundRadius
symbols.summary: Limits the audibility radius of attached and triggered scripted sounds to distance radius.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Maximum distance in meters at which the sounds can be heard.

symbols.name: ll.SetStatus
symbols.summary: Sets the object status attributes specified by status to value.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Bitmask representing the STATUS_* flag(s) to change.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables the status; if FALSE, disables it.

symbols.name: ll.SetText
symbols.signature: ll.SetText(text: string, color: vector, alpha: number): ()
symbols.summary: Displays floating text above the prim with the specified color vector and transparency alpha.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Floating text string to display.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color vector in RGB <R, G, B> (values from 0.0 to 1.0).

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Transparency value to set, from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid).

symbols.name: ll.SetTexture
symbols.summary: Applies the Blinn-Phong diffuse texture to face of the prim.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.description: Name of a texture in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

symbols.name: ll.SetTextureAnim
symbols.signature: ll.SetTextureAnim(mode: number, face: number, sizex: number, sizey: number, start: number, length: number, rate: number): ()
symbols.summary: Animates the texture on face of the prim by setting its scale and offset. mode defines options, sizex/sizey define frames, start defines the start frame/angle, length defines duration, and rate defines playback speed.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Bitfield of texture animation mode flags (ANIM_ON, LOOP, etc.).

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Face number or ALL_SIDES.

parameters.name: sizex
parameters.description: Number of horizontal frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

parameters.name: sizey
parameters.description: Number of vertical frames (ignored for ROTATE and SCALE).

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start frame number (or radians for ROTATE).

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Number of frames to display (or radians for ROTATE).

parameters.name: rate
parameters.description: Playback rate in frames per second (or radians/sec for ROTATE, UV coords/sec for SMOOTH). Must not be zero.

symbols.name: ll.SetTorque
symbols.summary: Applies a constant torque rotational force to a physical object. If local is TRUE, torque is applied in local coordinates; if FALSE, applied in global coordinates.

parameters.name: torque
parameters.description: Torque rotational force vector.

parameters.name: is_local
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, torque is treated as a local vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

symbols.name: ll.SetTouchText
symbols.summary: Displays the string text instead of 'Touch' in the right-click context menu.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Context menu text to display.

symbols.name: ll.SetVehicleFlags
symbols.summary: Enables the vehicle flags specified in the Flags bitmask.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: A bitwise mask of VEHICLE_FLAG_* constants to enable.

symbols.name: ll.SetVehicleFloatParam
symbols.summary: Sets the specified vehicle float parameter param to value.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: VEHICLE_* float parameter constant to set.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Float value to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetVehicleRotationParam
symbols.summary: Sets the specified vehicle rotation parameter param to rot.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: VEHICLE_* rotation parameter constant to set.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Rotation value to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetVehicleType
symbols.summary: Sets the vehicle physics preset type to one of the default vehicle types.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: VEHICLE_TYPE_* constant to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetVehicleVectorParam
symbols.summary: Sets the specified vehicle vector parameter param to vec.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: VEHICLE_* vector parameter constant to set.

parameters.name: vec
parameters.description: Vector value to set.

symbols.name: ll.SetVelocity
symbols.summary: Sets the linear velocity of a physical object to velocity. If local is TRUE, velocity is treated as a local directional vector; if FALSE, as a global region directional vector. Has no effect on non-physical objects.

parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: Linear velocity vector to apply (in meters per second).

parameters.name: is_local
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, velocity is treated as a local directional vector; if FALSE, as a global region vector.

symbols.name: ll.Shout
symbols.summary: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("shout_range"), which is 100m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

parameters.name: channel
