parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to broadcast.

symbols.name: ll.SignRSA
symbols.signature: ll.SignRSA(private_key: string, msg: string, algorithm: string): string
symbols.summary: Returns the Base64-encoded RSA signature of msg using the PEM-formatted private_key and the specified digest algorithm (sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512). Can be paired with llVerifyRSA to pass verifiable messages.

parameters.name: private_key
parameters.description: PEM-formatted private key.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message contents to sign.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Digest algorithm to use (sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, or sha512).

symbols.name: ll.Sin
symbols.summary: Returns the sine of theta. Theta is in radians.

parameters.name: theta
parameters.description: Angle in radians.

symbols.name: ll.SitOnLink
symbols.summary: Forces the avatar specified by agent_id (who must be participating in the experience) to sit on the sit target of the prim indicated by link. If occupied, searches down the linkset for an available sit target. Returns an integer.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar being forced to sit.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Link number for the prim containing the desired sit target.

symbols.name: ll.SitTarget
symbols.summary: Sets the sit target position (offset) and rotation (rot) relative to the prim's position and orientation. Clears the sit target if offset is ZERO_VECTOR.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Target position vector in local prim coordinates.

parameters.name: rot
parameters.description: Target rotation relative to the prim's rotation.

symbols.name: ll.Sleep
symbols.summary: Puts the script to sleep for sec seconds (at least until the next server-frame, ~0.02222 seconds). The script is inactive during this time. If sec is 0.0 or less, the script does not sleep.

parameters.name: sec
parameters.description: Duration in seconds to put the script to sleep.

symbols.name: ll.Sound
symbols.signature: ll.Sound(sound: string | uuid, volume: number, queue: boolean | number, loop: boolean | number): ()
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llPlaySound instead). Plays the specified sound at volume, with options to loop or queue the sound.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, queues the sound; if FALSE, interrupts the currently playing sound.

parameters.name: loop
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, loops the sound.

symbols.name: ll.SoundPreload
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llPreloadSound instead). Preloads the specified sound on viewers within range.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

symbols.name: ll.Sqrt
symbols.summary: Returns the square root of val. If negative, return NaN.

parameters.name: val
parameters.description: Positive float value (must be >= 0.0).

symbols.name: ll.StartAnimation
symbols.summary: Starts the animation anim (inventory or built-in) on the avatar who granted the script the PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION permission (automatically granted for attached or sat-on objects).

parameters.name: anim
parameters.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, or the built-in animation name.

symbols.name: ll.StartObjectAnimation
symbols.summary: Starts the specified animation anim (inventory or built-in) on the rigged mesh object associated with the current script.

parameters.name: anim
parameters.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, or the built-in animation name.

symbols.name: ll.StopAnimation
symbols.summary: Stops the specified animation anim (inventory, built-in, or UUID) on the avatar who granted the script the PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION permission (automatically granted for attached or sat-on objects).

parameters.name: anim
parameters.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, the UUID of the animation, or the built-in animation name.

symbols.name: ll.StopHover
symbols.summary: Stops the hover behavior (such as that initiated by llSetHoverHeight).

symbols.name: ll.StopLookAt
symbols.summary: Stops causing the object to look at or point toward a target (canceling llLookAt or llRotLookAt).

symbols.name: ll.StopMoveToTarget
symbols.summary: Stops the critically damped movement of the object toward a target (canceling llMoveToTarget). Use llStopLookAt to stop rotational tracking.

symbols.name: ll.StopObjectAnimation
symbols.summary: Stops the specified animation anim (inventory, built-in, or UUID) on the rigged mesh object associated with the current script.

parameters.name: anim
parameters.description: Name of the animation in the prim's inventory, the UUID of the animation, or the built-in animation name.

symbols.name: ll.StopSound
symbols.summary: Stops playback of the currently playing attached sound.

symbols.name: ll.StringLength
symbols.summary: Returns the number of unicode codepoints in the string.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: String to measure.

symbols.name: ll.StringToBase64
symbols.summary: Returns the Base64 representation string of str, interpreting it as a UTF-8 byte sequence.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: Source string to encode.

symbols.name: ll.StringTrim
symbols.summary: Returns a copy of the string src with leading, trailing, or both types of whitespace (including spaces, tabs, and line feeds) eliminated, according to the specified trim type.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: String to trim.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Trim type flag (STRING_TRIM_HEAD, STRING_TRIM_TAIL, or STRING_TRIM).

symbols.name: ll.SubStringIndex
symbols.summary: Returns the codepoint index of the first occurrence of pattern inside the string source. Returns nil if not found. No regex.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source string to search within.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Substring pattern to search for.

symbols.name: ll.TakeCamera
symbols.summary: Deprecated (use llSetCameraParams instead). Formerly used to take control of the agent's camera.

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar in the same region.

symbols.name: ll.TakeControls
symbols.signature: ll.TakeControls(controls: number, accept: boolean | number, pass_on: boolean | number): ()
symbols.summary: Intercepts inputs (keyboard/mouse clicks) from the agent, specifically those specified by controls. The boolean accept determines if events are generated, and pass_on determines if inputs also perform their default functions. Requires the PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS runtime permission.

parameters.name: controls
parameters.description: Bitfield of CONTROL_* flags to intercept.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Boolean. Determines whether control events are generated to trigger script handlers.

parameters.name: pass_on
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, the keys also perform their default functions; if FALSE, default actions are suppressed.

symbols.name: ll.Tan
symbols.summary: Returns the tangent of theta. Theta is in radians.

parameters.name: theta
parameters.description: Angle in radians.

symbols.name: ll.Target
symbols.summary: Registers a positional target at position with a leeway radius range. This triggers at_target and not_at_target events. Returns an integer handle to unregister the target via llTargetRemove.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Target position vector in region coordinates.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Radius tolerance in meters surrounding the target position.

symbols.name: ll.TargetOmega
symbols.signature: ll.TargetOmega(axis: vector, spinrate: number, gain: number): ()
symbols.summary: Applies a smooth client-side rotation around the local axis at a rate equal to spinrate multiplied by the magnitude of axis (in radians per second) with a force defined by gain. Set spinrate to 0.0 to cancel.

parameters.name: axis
parameters.description: Local axis vector around which the object rotates.

parameters.name: spinrate
parameters.description: Rotation rate multiplier in radians per second.

parameters.name: gain
parameters.description: A float modulating the rotational strength (disables the rotation if set to 0.0).

symbols.name: ll.TargetRemove
symbols.summary: Removes the positional target specified by the integer handle registered with llTarget.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Integer target handle returned by llTarget to remove.

symbols.name: ll.TargetedEmail
symbols.signature: ll.TargetedEmail(target: number, subject: string, msg: string): ()
symbols.summary: Sends an email to with the given subject subject and body msg to the target (which can designate the owner or creator of the object). The email will be sent from `{ll.GetKey()}@lsl.secondlife.com`.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Target constant (e.g., TARGETED_EMAIL_OBJECT_OWNER or TARGETED_EMAIL_ROOT_CREATOR).

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject of the email.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Email message body.

symbols.name: ll.TeleportAgent
symbols.signature: ll.TeleportAgent(agent: uuid, landmark: string, position: vector, look_at: vector): ()
symbols.summary: Teleports the owning agent (who must grant PERMISSION_TELEPORT) to a landmark in the object's inventory. If landmark is empty, teleports them to position within the current region. Upon arrival, the agent is turned to face look_at. Can only teleport the owner.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the owning avatar to teleport.

parameters.name: landmark
parameters.description: Name of the landmark in the prim's inventory, or an empty string to teleport locally.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Position vector in local region coordinates to teleport to if landmark is empty.

parameters.name: look_at
parameters.description: Position vector (or direction unit vector if teleporting out of region) the agent faces upon landing.

symbols.name: ll.TeleportAgentGlobalCoords
symbols.signature: ll.TeleportAgentGlobalCoords(agent: uuid, global_coordinates: vector, region_coordinates: vector, look_at: vector): ()
symbols.summary: Teleports the owning agent (who must grant PERMISSION_TELEPORT) to region_coordinates within a target region specified by global_coordinates. Upon landing, the agent faces the direction look_at. Can only teleport the owner.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the owning avatar to teleport.

parameters.name: global_coordinates
parameters.description: Global coordinates vector of the target region (obtained via llRequestSimulatorData).

parameters.name: region_coordinates
parameters.description: Target coordinates vector within the destination region.

parameters.name: look_at
parameters.description: Position vector within the region (or unit direction vector if out of region) that the agent faces upon landing.

symbols.name: ll.TeleportAgentHome
symbols.summary: Teleports the avatar (who must be standing on land owned by the script owner) directly to their designated home location without warning (similar to a God Summons).

parameters.name: avatar
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to teleport.

symbols.name: ll.TextBox
symbols.signature: ll.TextBox(agent: uuid, msg: string, channel: number): ()
symbols.summary: Opens an input text box dialog displaying msg to the agent. Submitting text chats the input string on channel as if said by the agent. The chat originates at the object's position, but uses the agent's name and UUID, so it can be heard as long as the agent is still in the region.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the agent in the same region.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message to display in the text box.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Output chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) where the input text is chatted.

symbols.name: ll.ToLower
symbols.summary: Returns a lowercase copy of the string src. Converts all unicode characters, not just ASCII.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to convert.

symbols.name: ll.ToUpper
symbols.summary: Returns an uppercase copy of the string src. Converts all unicode characters, not just ASCII.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source string to convert.

symbols.name: ll.TransferLindenDollars
symbols.summary: Transfers amount of L$ from the script owner to the destination avatar, requiring the PERMISSION_DEBIT permission. Returns a key query handle matching the resulting transaction_result event.

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: UUID of the destination avatar.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Quantity of L$ to transfer (must be greater than 0).

symbols.name: ll.TransferOwnership
symbols.signature: ll.TransferOwnership(agent: uuid, flags: number, options: list): number
symbols.summary: Transfers ownership of the object (or a copy of it, depending on Flags) to the specified agent. Returns an integer indicating the success or failure of the transfer.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: UUID of the agent to receive ownership of the object.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags controlling the transfer type (such as TRANSFER_FLAG_COPY or TRANSFER_FLAG_TAKE).

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Extra options applied to the transfer (currently unused).

symbols.name: ll.TriggerSound
symbols.summary: Plays specified sound once at volume, centered at the object's current position but not attached (does not move with the object and cannot be stopped or adjusted). Does not affect attached sounds.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

symbols.name: ll.TriggerSoundLimited
symbols.signature: ll.TriggerSoundLimited(sound: string | uuid, volume: number, top_north_east: vector, bottom_south_west: vector): ()
symbols.summary: Plays the specified sound once at volume, centered at the object but not attached, restricted to the axis-aligned bounding box defined by the coordinates top_north_east and bottom_south_west.

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Name of a sound in the prim's inventory, or a UUID.

parameters.name: volume
parameters.description: Volume level to set, between 0.0 (silent) and 1.0 (loud).

parameters.name: top_north_east
parameters.description: Top-north-east boundary position vector in region coordinates.

parameters.name: bottom_south_west
parameters.description: Bottom-south-west boundary position vector in region coordinates.

symbols.name: ll.UnSit
symbols.summary: Forces the agent specified by id to stand up if they are sitting on the object containing the script, or are currently over land owned by the object's owner.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the avatar to unsit.

symbols.name: ll.UnescapeURL
symbols.summary: Returns a string representing the unescaped/decoded version of url, replacing '%20' with spaces and decoding raw UTF-8 characters.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Escaped URL string to decode.

symbols.name: ll.UpdateCharacter
symbols.summary: Updates settings for a pathfinding character using the parameters specified in options.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of key-value pairs specifying the character's new configuration options (takes same constants as llCreateCharacter).

symbols.name: ll.UpdateKeyValue
symbols.signature: ll.UpdateKeyValue(k: string, v: string, checked: boolean | number, original_value: string): uuid
symbols.summary: Starts an asynchronous transaction to update the key k to value v inside the experience datastore. If checked is TRUE, the update fails with XP_ERROR_RETRY_UPDATE unless the existing value matches original_value.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Key of the key-value pair to update.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: New value for the key-value pair.

parameters.name: checked
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, requires the existing value to match original_value to complete the update; if FALSE, creates the key if needed.

parameters.name: original_value
parameters.description: String value to compare against the existing value in the datastore.

symbols.name: ll.VecDist
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the undirected, non-negative distance between vectors vec_a and vec_b.

parameters.name: vec_a
parameters.description: First vector.

parameters.name: vec_b
parameters.description: Second vector.

symbols.name: ll.VecMag
symbols.summary: Returns the magnitude (geometric length) of vec.

parameters.name: vec
parameters.description: Vector to evaluate.

symbols.name: ll.VecNorm
symbols.summary: Returns the normalized unit vector pointing the same direction as vec. If <0, 0, 0>, return <0, 0, 0>.

parameters.name: vec
parameters.description: Vector to normalize.

symbols.name: ll.VerifyRSA
symbols.signature: ll.VerifyRSA(public_key: string, msg: string, signature: string, algorithm: string): boolean
symbols.summary: Returns TRUE if the Base64-formatted signature is verified as valid for the message msg when using the digest algorithm and public_key. Returns FALSE otherwise.

parameters.name: public_key
parameters.description: PEM-formatted public key to use for signature verification.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message string that was signed.

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: Base64-encoded signature to verify.

parameters.name: algorithm
parameters.description: Cryptographic digest algorithm to use.

symbols.name: ll.VolumeDetect
symbols.summary: If detect is TRUE, enables VolumeDetect (object becomes phantom and physical objects/avatars can pass through it). Triggers collision_start on initial intersection and collision_end when intersection stops (standard collision events are suppressed while intersecting).

parameters.name: detect
parameters.description: Boolean. If TRUE, enables VolumeDetect; if FALSE (default), disables it.

symbols.name: ll.WanderWithin
symbols.signature: ll.WanderWithin(origin: vector, dist: vector, options: list): ()
symbols.summary: Directs a pathfinding character to wander around a central coordinate origin, restricted within the bounding distance limits of dist and configured by options.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Center coordinate position vector to wander about.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.description: A vector specifying the maximum distance limits (half-extents) along each world-aligned axis from the origin.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: A list of WANDER_* flags and parameters to configure the wander behavior.

symbols.name: ll.Water
symbols.summary: Returns a float representing the water height directly below the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: ll.Whisper
symbols.summary: Broadcasts the message msg to all scripts or agents listening on channel within llGetEnv("whisper_range"), which is 10m on most regions. Agents listen on PUBLIC_CHANNEL (0) and DEBUG_CHANNEL (2147483647). All other channels are for script-to-script communication.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Chat channel (any 32-bit signed integer value) to whisper the message on.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Text message string to broadcast.

symbols.name: ll.Wind
symbols.summary: Returns a vector representing the wind velocity at the prim's position offset by the vector offset.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset relative to the prim's position, expressed in local coordinates.

symbols.name: ll.WorldPosToHUD

parameters.name: world_pos
parameters.description: World-frame position vector to project into HUD space.

symbols.name: ll.XorBase64

parameters.description: First Base64 string.

parameters.name: str2

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: First Base64 string.

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: Second Base64 string (will repeat if shorter than str1).

symbols.name: ll.sRGB2Linear
symbols.summary: Returns a linear RGB colorspace vector converted from the sRGB colorspace argument.
